title: Pre-Crime Studio: monthly hotspot forecasting of vehicle theft and robbery in São Paulo
description: Code for grid construction, feature pipeline, prospective replay forecasts and evaluation of monthly crime hotspot forecasts of vehicle theft and robbery in São Paulo, Brazil. Version used in the manuscripts 'Information, not architecture: what limits monthly hotspot forecasts of vehicle theft and robbery in São Paulo' and 'The winner depends on the measurement: silent errors and legitimate choices that reorder crime hotspot forecasts'.
